apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.empty: The card renders a fixed portal link, one cancel button and a confirm dialog with a fixed four-item list of lost features; it owns no collection that can be empty.
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.error: The section takes no error prop: handleCancelSubscription belongs to the billing page, which reports a failed cancellation itself; this card only shows the pending confirm button (PendingCancellation story).
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.offline: The section makes no request of its own; the cancel mutation and its network failure live in the billing page that passes handleCancelSubscription and cancelMutationPending.
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.permission-denied: Only a subscribed user reaches this card and every subscriber may cancel; the detector matched PRO_PLAN_DISPLAY_NAME, which is the plan name in the dialog copy.
The header renders the same title and plan sentence for every viewer; the detector matched the word plan in getPlanDisplayName(plan), which only names the plan.

apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.empty: The skeleton maps a fixed three-entry PLAN_CARD_SKELETONS constant; it takes no data, so there is nothing that can be empty.
apps/web/components/organisms/billing/Bi.offline: The skeleton takes no props and makes no request; connectivity belongs to the billing page that shows it while its own queries load.

apps/web/components/organisms/combobox/C.offline: The dropdown makes no request; it renders isLoading, query and filteredOptions handed down by Combobox, whose caller owns the artist search and its network failure.
apps/web/components/organisms/combobox/C.permission-denied: Anyone typing an artist name sees the same suggestions; the detector matched role='status' on the live region that announces search progress.

apps/web/components/organisms/combobox/C.loading: The only loading frame is the image shimmer shown until next/image fires onLoad, which lasts as long as the network does, so no story can hold it; the shimmer is asserted in ComboboxOptionItem.certificate.test.tsx.
apps/web/components/organisms/combobox/C.empty: The row renders exactly one option passed in by ComboboxDropdown; an empty list is the dropdown's no-results state (ComboboxDropdown EmptySearchResults story).
apps/web/components/organisms/combobox/C.offline: The row makes no request; an image that cannot load while offline takes the same initials fallback as the ErrorImageFallback story.

apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.error: The provider draws no error UI of its own: it passes the updater's error phase to DesktopUpdateModal, whose ErrorState and ErrorNotRetryable stories show it; a browser canvas has no update bridge, so the provider renders only children.
apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.long-content: The provider has no copy of its own; it renders children plus DesktopUpdateModal, whose AvailableLongNotes story covers long release notes.
apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.permission-denied: Updates need no permission; the detector matched the comment 'passive update announcements still wait behind permission/error notices', which is about banner priority.
apps/web/components/organisms/desktop-up.rtl-overflow: The provider has no copy of its own; text direction belongs to its children and to DesktopUpdateModal, which renders the update copy.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.offline: The panel makes no request: prompt, reply and pending come from the Home canvas owner that streams the turn, so a dropped connection reaches it only as the pending or empty reply already shown in LoadingReply and EmptyReply.

The canvas makes no request; it renders loopStatus and asksStatus from the Home page reads, and an offline read lands as their error status, shown with retry in the ErrorState and PartialShippingReadFailed stories.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.error: The board takes no error input; a failed shipping read is drawn by the enclosing HomeLoopSection (its ErrorState story). The detector matched the border-l-error and text-error classes that mark blocked cards.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.offline: The pulse row and banner make no request; they render tiles and a constraint passed in, and an unavailable read shows as the unknown banner with empty frames (ErrorReadUnknown).
apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.permission-denied: Every Home viewer sees the same tiles; the detector matched role='status' on the constraint banner and role='img' on the tone dots.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.offline: The section makes no request; it renders the status its caller passes, and an offline read arrives as status='error' with the retry button (ErrorState and LongContentError stories).
apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.permission-denied: A section has no gated content; the detector matched role='alert' on the error line and role='status' on the source notice.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.error: The rows take no error input; a failed read is drawn by the enclosing HomeLoopSection. The detector matched the bg-error and text-error classes that mark a blocked row.
apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.offline: The rows make no request; they render rows passed in by the Home loop, whose failed or offline read is shown by HomeLoopSection's error state.

apps/web/components/organisms/home-loop/.error: The strip takes no error input; when the loop read fails the canvas passes items=[] and it shows its empty label (EmptyNotMeasured). The detector matched the text-error-text tone class for slow values.

apps/web/components/organisms/profile-sh.loading: Only next/dynamic fallbacks load: null for PayDrawer and a static idle ProfileNotificationsButton; no loading UI of the shell's own.
apps/web/components/organisms/profile-sh.error: Detector matched the '// @ts-expect-error - joviePixel' comments; the shell has no error UI.
apps/web/components/organisms/profile-sh.offline: The shell makes no request of its own; detector matched the next/dynamic 'loading:' option.

apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.empty: Renders one message and its action; there is no collection to be empty.

apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.partial: Takes one status plus optional feedback; there is no partial data.
apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.permission-denied: False positive on role='status'; the row has no permission gate.
A 403 shows the same 'Analytics unavailable' line as ErrorLoadingAnalytics; detector matched the test-auth bypass constants.

apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.error: Copy failures surface only as app Toaster toasts ('Failed to copy ISRC' / 'Failed to copy link'), asserted in TrackDetailPanel.certificate.test.tsx.

apps/web/components/organisms/release-si.empty: Renders one track's metadata; there is no collection to be empty.

apps/web/components/organisms/table/Noir.empty: Fixed specimen with no props or data; its rows are always the four state rows.
apps/web/components/organisms/table/Noir.long-content: Fixed specimen copy with no props; there is no variable content to overflow.
apps/web/components/organisms/table/Noir.offline: Static specimen that makes no request.
